sets.relationshipLabel: mild instance of a phenomenon intensifies into its severe counterpart
sets.explanation: A gentle breeze can escalate into a gale, just as a light drizzle can build into a downpour.

sets.relationshipLabel: violent weather event leaves scattered physical destruction
sets.explanation: A storm leaves wreckage behind just as a tornado scatters debris in its wake.

sets.relationshipLabel: gradual accumulation causes sudden destructive event
sets.explanation: Rain accumulates into a flood, and snow accumulates into an avalanche, both tipping over into sudden disaster.

sets.relationshipLabel: an underlying condition supplies the fuel that lets a larger phenomenon form
sets.explanation: Humidity is the hidden fuel behind fog, just as warm ocean water is the hidden fuel behind a hurricane.
